'''Saol-sar''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the war, Saol-sar sold [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]] in the [[Equipment Requisitions (Senate Commercial District)|Equipment Requisitions]] area of the [[Senate Commercial District]], a market located underneath the [[Senate Plaza/Legends|Senate Plaza]] on the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TOR" />

Saol-sar had [[Color/Legends|green]] skin and [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and a darker green pattern of [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]] on their [[Lekku/Legends|lekku]]. They wore a blue [[Clothing/Legends|outfit]] with a dark [[Belt/Legends|belt]], [[Glove/Legends|gloves]], and [[Boot/Legends|boots]], along with a piece of white cloth around his neck. Saol-sar [[Language/Legends|spoke]] [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] to customers.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Saol-sar first appeared in the [[Roleplaying game|massively-multiplayer online roleplaying]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" /> Their position is marked by a map in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', a game guide for ''The Old Republic'', where they are identified as "Saol Sar," without the hyphen.<ref name="Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
